'''Ratts Race''' was a game commonly played by the citizens of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at [[Jabba's Game Plaza]]. It was named after the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]], who was a known enthusiast for the game. The object of Ratts Race was to reach the center square of the board and grab the "[[Globe of Peace/Legends|Globe of Peace]]" before the opponent did. The first one to do so won all the [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi]] mustered by both players during the game.
